messages:
zara (partnerships): Quick sync note: Cedar Systems shipped a Cedar-4U pre-prod board for our perf/W bakeoff. Need to agree on an experiment matrix and ownership. I sketched a plan below, please flag blockers.

aj (hw-eng): Cedar reported kernel v5.19 + thermal-fix-rc2. I'll verify exact firmware image and publish a sha. We should add two intermediate voltage steps, not just +/-5.

linus (perf): Good call on midpoints. Suggest we capture P95 and also 99th for tail analysis. We should target both steady-state and cold-start latencies.

maria (pm): Goal: produce a short marketplace summary after validation. Non-negotiable SLA: P95 <= 120ms for the primary config. Marketing needs a green light from legal before any perf/W numbers go public.

cedar-eng (Cedar Systems): We can provide bench access Wed-Thu, VPN + IPMI creds. Firmware: cedar-4u-v1.3.2, sha256: abc123def456... We'll spin up a bench user for bench-bot. Recommended voltage deltas: -7.5%, -2.5%, 0%, +2.5%, +7.5%.

zara (partnerships): Draft matrix (compact): models=[ggml-small, redwood-base, redwood-opt-q4]; seq=[128,512,2048]; conc=[1,4,8]; power=[-7.5,-2.5,0,2.5,7.5,turbo]; kernel toggles=[preemptive-sched, llc-flush, rtx-therm-v2]; metrics=[tokens/s, J/token, tokens/s/W, P50/P95/P99]; runs=3 cold + 5 steady per cell.

aj (hw-eng): We'll add scripts to flip BIOS knobs and apply/unapply rtx-therm-v2. Need to capture RAPL, IPMI inlet/outlet temps, and board power. I'll open infra PR infra/bench-scripts#421 with helpers.

linus (perf): Data collection wrapper example:
```
./bench_runner --model redwood-base --seq 512 --conc 4 --dur 300 \
  --power /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj --ipmi --out results.csv
```
Bench-bot will push artifacts to s3://redwood-partner/cedar/cedar4u-calib/. We'll tag runs with X-Partner:Cedar and bench-run-id.

bench-bot: created job cedar4u-bakeoff-1725558000 scheduled nightly x3. Logs: /var/log/bench/cedar4u/*.gz.

maria (pm): Ownership (proposal): Redwood=bench harness, models, analysis notebooks, dashboard; Cedar=hardware, firmware, BIOS knobs; Joint=sign-off and marketplace copy. Also include checkbox for publication consent routed to legal.

zara (partnerships): Timeline: Mon finalize scripts + matrix; Wed-Thu runs; Fri analysis pass; following Mon decision on if kernel/microcode follow-ups needed. Can everyone commit?

cedar-eng (Cedar Systems): Wed-Thu works; minor smoke test Wed morning may delay earliest run. Legal consent ok, we'll route through counsel.

aj (hw-eng): PR up by EOD with toggles and small utility to read board sensors. I'll post firmware sha and the BIOS baseline.

linus (perf): For analysis I'll produce perf/W scatter + latency contour heatmaps and a short notebook describing methodology and failure modes. Example CSV preview:
model,config,throughput,tokens_per_j,P95
redwood-base,stock,1180,0.92,128
redwood-base,volt-7.5,980,1.05,145

zara (partnerships): Action items recap: aj=firmware hash+PR, cedar=VPN+bench user, linus=analysis notebook, maria=marketplace blurb draft + legal loop. I'll send a calendar invite and keep this thread updated. :rocket:
